CAMPAIGN_NAME: Heavy metals in tissues of Atlantic and Pacific walruses
PROTOCOL_COMMENT: Skin samples from O. r. rosmarus were collected using steel tips for arrows. Steel composition 12X18H10: 0.12% carbon (C), 18% chromium (Cr), 10% nickel (Ni), <0.8% titanium (Ti). Depth 1.5-2 cm, width 0.5 cm, weight about 5 g. Samples from O. r. divergens collected using medical scalpel. Skin samples about 2 cm depth and 2 cm width, weight about 15 g. Organ samples taken from any part, weight not less 15 g.

CAMPAIGN_NAME: Heavy metals in tissues of Atlantic and Pacific walruses
PROTOCOL_COMMENT: Biomaterial samples were thawed at room temperature. Before analysis 1 to 5 g of sample was ashed in a muffle furnace at 450°C. The ash was dissolved in diluted nitric acid.
